verdict.rationale: Asana's own MCP server documentation says AI assistants can "Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data". That is a first-party path to AI-drafted summaries, but it does not specifically cover status updates. Other evidence (AI Teammates, Asana Dash "AI Chief of Staff", and a tutorial for reading status updates via the API) is either generic marketing or a developer building block, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented native AI feature that drafts project or initiative status updates, evidence that drafts are built from recent activity, coverage of initiative or portfolio-level updates, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity

citations.quote: Generate reports and summaries based on Asana data
